# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers in Bosenmori Basho, set as received. The Herald does not vouch for any of it. Notices run free.[/italic]
## Housing - [bold]ROOM TO LET[/bold], Living Sector. Warm, dry and next to the scrubber vents, so it is never quiet. Own mask locker. Ask at the cargo desk. - [bold]WANTED[/bold], bunk space for an atmos apprentice off the next transport. Neat, sober and works nights. - Official allocations are posted by the colony at [netlink="Colony housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Work - [bold]FILTRATION HANDS WANTED[/bold] by the Filtration Department. Training given. Must pass a seal test and not panic in a suit. - [bold]SURVEY DRIVER[/bold] needed for Research Complex runs to the Field Research Site. Dust storm experience preferred.
## For Sale and Trade - [bold]REBREATHER FILTERS[/bold], factory sealed, twelve to a box. Will trade for real tea, not the ration kind. - [bold]PRESSURE SUIT[/bold], seals bench tested by an atmos engineer, visor scratched. Fair offers only.
## Lost and Found - [bold]LOST[/bold]: one glove, left hand, insulated, somewhere on Pilgrim Path. It will not have gone far. - [bold]FOUND[/bold]: an IASF beret near the North Barrens tower. The owner may collect it at the press office and explain how it got there.
## Notices - To the paratroopers training in the West Barrens: the hab roofs are not a drop zone. Signed, the residents of the west habs. - The names are read at the memorial wall at the north end of Pilgrim Path on the last rest day of every month. Walkers leave together from the colony exit gate. Masks on, all are welcome.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page.
